Health is one of the Character Stats for Characters.

## Contents

- 1 Overview

- 1.1 Limit and Regeneration

- 1.2 Mitigations

- 1.3 Downed Characters

- 2 UI

- 3 Maximum Health

- 4 Low/High Health Threshold

## Overview[]

Health is a regenerating resource that determines how much damage a character can take before dying. Taking hits and using some Skills depletes the health pool.

### Limit and Regeneration[]

The health pool can be increased by gaining levels on a character, as well as building Vitality, equipping items with various Affix Shards, and through certain Passives. Health is regenerated naturally at a rate of 6 HP / second, which can be regained additionally to the above ways through Health Regeneration, the Potion, and Leech.

### Mitigations[]

Hits against health can be mitigated by Resistances, Endurance, Armor, Block, Dodge, Critical Strike Reduction and Critical Strike Avoidance.

### Downed Characters[]

When a character's Health reaches zero, they are downed. Depending on type, characters have different downed states:

- Players die. They must forfeit their progress and can resurrected at the nearest checkpoint. Hardcore player characters are also moved to their respective Softcore group.

- Minions and totems also die. They are removed from the level and they can be summoned again. The oldest minion of a type also dies, when summoning a minion would exceed the limit for that type.

- Companions do not die right away. Instead, they are left in an immobilized state, during which they can be revived by a Player standing close to them. The Player has a limited time for the revival, and failing to do so result's in the Companion's death. Dead companions can be re-summoned.

## UI[]

The health orb in the lower left displays the maximum health and current health of the active player character. As the player's health goes down, the light centered around the player will gradually shift to red.

The maximum Health is also displayed in the Character Stats and Inventory windows.

Moving the mouse over the globe reveals a detailed tooltip about health-related stats, as well as the globe will be partially covered in yellow, indicating the enduranc threshold.e

## Maximum Health[]

Each character has an absolute maximum amount of Health. The maximum may be raised or lowered but can not be exceeded, even temporarily.

At the start of the game, each character begins with a maximum Health of 100. This is increased by:

- the character gaining 8 points of Health for each level they have.

- Modifiers that add a fixed amount or an increased percentage to the character's Health.

The Maximum Health also plays a role in the Combat Calculations in determining the character's defensive stats.

## Low/High Health Threshold[]

Characters are considered at low health when their health drops to 35% (or below) of their maximum health. Conversely, the inverse logic applies to high health for the rate of 65% (or higher) of maximum health. This threshold is used for bonuses that are granted "while at low/high health".
